title: Buy what can follow you
summary: This meets the ache to secure yourself by gathering more. The line asks a cleaner question: what can still follow you when the deal, the object, and the image are gone?
takeaway: Choose the gain that can follow you.
lifeApplication: Before you buy, upgrade, or chase the next win, stop with your hand on the card or screen. Ask whether this choice is feeding appetite or building the kind of wealth that can remain.

source.shortMeaning: Choose the wealth that remains when possessions cannot follow you.
source.lifeApplication: At the point of purchase, ask what here can remain beyond display.
